desc: t

The Thai people migrated from South China to Indochina centuries ago, where they discovered a land crossed by trade and influences from both India and China. Drinking from both sources, as well as from the presence of Hinduism and Buddhism, the Thai developed its own unique identity, creating polities that are able to stand on equal footing to those by the former rulers, the Mon people, who have seen their territory reduced and many of their old kingdoms supplanted by Thai ones. This has also caused the Empire of Khmer to slip into decline, and they have subsequently lost much of its previous influence. Only time can tell to what further heights the Thai will be able to reach.

One of the Mon kingdoms that suffered a downfall was Lavo, which was not only conquered by the Thai but also split into the Thai kingdoms of Suphanburi and Lavo. The latter, although they retained their name from the Mon period, was under Thai rule, which was itself under the suzerainty of the Empire of Khmer.

However, Empire of Khmer has waned in power in recent years, which not only enabled the creation of an independent Kingdom of Sukhothai, but also allowed Lavo to remove its shackles. In the midst of these nascent independent kingdoms, the developing settlement of Ayodhya also shows promise of expansion. The opportunity for great change has finally appeared to us.
entities.name: Ayodhya

desc: t

The Crown of Aragon stands proudly as a significant power in the western Mediterranean region, thanks to its maritime prowess, diplomatic weight, and flourishing trade networks.

The stabilization of the Kingdom of Valencia and the ongoing conquest of the newly-created Kingdom of Sardinia and Corsica might ensure its dominance of the seas. However, despite its relative stability, challenges loom on the horizon. To the East, the Kingdom of Mallorca faces economic difficulties, and its ruler's animosity towards GetCountry('ARA') might lead to conflict. In the peninsula, the threat of the Crown of Castile is becoming more and more real as the ''Reconquista'' comes to an end. To the north, the Kingdom of France have consolidated their dominion over the Languedoc in the last century.

How should the young GetCountry('ARA') face the challenges to come? Will GetCountry('ARA') focus on the Mediterranean Sea and rule the waves from Barcelona to the Holy Land? Will GetCountry('ARA') turn around and claim dominance over Iberia? Or will GetCountry('ARA') try to get revenge for the Battle of Muret in 1213, and recover long-lost ancient holdings north of the Pyrenees?
entities.name: Aragon

desc: t

Armenian people have been living in these lands since antiquity, their nation having originated at the foot of Mount Ararat. Fiercely proud of having been the first nation to embrace Christianity, they have survived invasions from Islam, Persia, and Turkic peoples, although they have seen themselves divided into multiple smaller kingdoms, and the glory of the great Armenian kingdom of the past is long gone.

However, Armenian people are resilient, and even after the recent Mongol invasions they survive, waiting for the moment to rise again. Although the County of Armenia finds itself currently under the authority of the Kingdom of Georgia, and also the Īlkhānān, it still has enough autonomy to act independently. Despite being a shadow of the former Armenian glory, the ruling Zakarid dynasty has managed to reestablish a consolidation of their rule, and continue standing proudly among the nations of the world.
entities.name: Armenia

desc: t

The lands of Bohemia are in the heart of the Germanic Holy Roman Empire, and inhabited by Slavic people. After a long period under the Přemyslid dynasty, the current luxembourg_dynasty rulers may drastically change matters by tightening the country's existing ties with the Empire, although GetCountry('BOH') is more Francien than German, having been educated in the royal court of Paris. Keeping both the GetCountry('BOH') and the GetCountry('BOH') satisfied under a foreign GetCountry('BOH'), while navigating the political intricacies of the Holy Roman Empire, would prove a hurdle for anybody. Fortunately, Bohemia is a strong GetCountry('BOH'), but will it succeed in its ambitions?
entities.name: Bohemia

desc: t

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of ubv_ludwig_iv_wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of GetCountry('UBV'), GetCountry('BOH'), and GetCountry('HAB') once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

The County of Brandenburg was established as the ''Northern March'' in the Slavic Wends' territory. The region features loamy uplands and depressions with abundant water and pine trees, heat, and dry, sandy soil, earning it the nickname  'the sandbox of the Holy Roman Empire'.

In 1157, after claiming these lands from Jaxa of Köpenick, bra_albrecht_i_askanier officially became GetCountry('BRA'). Initially limited to Havelland and Zauche, he encouraged the ''Ostsiedlung'''s process towards the Neumark east of the Oder, gradually incorporating it into his possessions. Colonists coming from Flanders and the Rhineland were invited to settle, fortifying their towns in the process.

After his death in 1170, the Askanier dynasty continued this expansion for over 150 years, acquiring neighboring regions like the Oder Lagoon and the Uckermark, which expanded their influence to the Baltic Sea. Unfortunately, this led to conflict with Denmark. However, the last Askanier, GetCharacter('bra heinrich ii askanier'), died without a direct heir in 1320.

Now, the Wittelsbach dynasty has arrived, but their lack of interest in ruling these lands casts a shadow over the future of the County of Brandenburg.
entities.name: Brandenburg

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Being one of the biggest and most populated nation in the Low Countries, we are obviously best suited to lead our neighbors, especially taking into account the weak position the Duchy of Flanders is in. Should we strike at the precise moment, we could elevate ourselves to the highest echelons, as we deserve...
entities.name: Brabant

desc: t

Once a proud GetCountry('BYZ') that stretched from Egypt and the Levant to Iberia and Italy, Byzantium now faces a period of almost inexorable decline caused by the shock of the Fourth Crusade, even after the recovery of Constantinople by the GetCountry('BYZ'). During GetCharacter('byz andronikos ii palaiologos') reign, byz_andronikos_ii_palaiologos saw fit to dissolve several key institutions, such as the Navy, in an attempt to save the dying economy of the country, while the Decayed Theme System continued to be a shadow of what it was, as the GetCountry('BYZ') lost territory across all fronts.

GetCharacter('byz andronikos ii palaiologos') successor, byz_andronikos_iii_palaiologos, is now faced with the difficult task of safeguarding what remains of our once-glorious GetCountry('BYZ'). To our east, Ottomans have started amassing a large army to wipe out our remaining holdings in Anatolia, threatening to set foot across the straits. At the same time, ser_stefan_dusan eyes Thessaloníki and Northern Epirus like a vulture. Meanwhile, our treasury runs dry of precious coin, and the country may yet be thrown into a perilous civil war, as the family of our GetCountry('BYZ') conspires with the GetCountry('BYZ') behind closed doors. Can the GetCountry('BYZ') lift this once-great nation from the ashes?
entities.name: Byzantium

desc: t

The Crown of Castile was formed through the union of its two constituent parts, the Kingdom of Castile and the Kingdom of León, when they were reunited after both titles were inherited by cas_fernando_iii_burgundy in 1230. A century later, cas_alfonso_xi_burgundy rules without much opposition, having overcome a troubled start to his reign following the end of a long regency under his grandmother, cas_maria_molina.

After reining in the nobility of the realm, led by his relative cas_juan_manuel, and having stabilized the governance of the country, cas_alfonso_xi_burgundy is now turning his attention to the southern border. The Duchy of Granada has menaced our country since the emirate became independent a century ago, backed by the powerful Kingdom of Morocco, which has a foothold on Iberia through a petty kingdom centered on Algeciras and Ronda, and held by mor_abu_malik_abd_al_wahid, son and heir of mor_abu_al_hasan_ali.

However, these are not the only troubles for cas_alfonso_xi_burgundy, as his relationship with his beloved mistress, cas_leonor_guzman, and GetCharacter('cas alfonso xi burgundy') children by GetCharacter('cas leonor guzman') have eroded the relationship with the king's actual wife, cas_maria_portugal, daughter of por_afonso_iv_portugal. With the latter living apart from the GetCountry('CAS'), this rift in the royal family now leaves the looming question of just who will succeed him when he passes.

Will cas_alfonso_xi_burgundy and his successors be able to deal with these threats to the Crown of Castile, both at home and abroad?
entities.name: Castile

desc: t

Champa is a collection of many different, somewhat autonomous Cham polities which have united to form a single GetCountry('CHA'). As the only Hinduism state in mainland Indochina, the people of the Kingdom of Champa face constant threat from the decaying Empire of Khmer to their west and the aggressive Kingdom of Đại Việt to their north. Despite these external threats, the seafaring acumen of the Champa people has allowed them to amass wealth and power over the seas of Indonesia.

Once a conglomerate of disparate groups, Champa has blossomed into a sophisticated force to be reckoned with, but will it take its rightful place as the ruler of all nations?
entities.name: Champa

desc: t

The great GetCharacter('genghis khan') Khān forged an empire of unparalleled strength and ambition for all Mongol peoples, bringing into his fold great swathes of land from Europe to China. People everywhere learned to fear the sound of the Mongol armies galloping through, and the might and power of the Great Khān.

As heirs of this legacy, our dream of restoring the glory of the greatest Mongol Horde burns passionately within us all.

chagatai_khan was the son of Genghis Khān, and therefore the heir to his legacy and empire.

Chagatai's situation at the center of the different Mongol states is of great importance, as the Silk Road crosses through our lands, and many of its most important cities are under our control. That puts Chagatai in the best position to control trade and communication between the other heirs of the Great Khān. And if any of those other heirs objects, we shall deal with them... decisively.
entities.name: Chagatai

desc: t

Established by kublai_khan, the Empire of Yuán(CHI) now controls the vast expanse of a great Empire. Having tamed China, and thriving under kublai_khan's legendary leadership, they have reached stratospheric heights of prestige and splendor.

However, their influence over the subcontinent is waning. Internal strife, instability, and cultural friction have corroded what once was prosperous and magnificent, and those who wish to dethrone the China and usurp their mandate are gathering their strength. Plotting and scheming within China's borders, these traitors seek to find every possible weakness within the Empire's rule, vying for scraps of power and a passing mention in the scrolls of history. But while many may struggle and die for the honor, only one leader can sit on the Dragon Throne and fulfill the will of Heaven.
entities.name: Yuán(CHI)

desc: t

The Town of Cahokia, a settlement built on a confluence of sacred rivers and blessed with fertile lands, has grown and evolved into a complex society. Life in Cahokia revolves around the cultivation of the surrounding fertile valley, where the Three Sisters — maize, beans, and squash — grow tall, and around bowing to the rule of the GetCountry('CHK'), who are prolific builders of temples. The culture of Cahokia has spread throughout the surrounding area, creating a vast sphere of influence and drawing new residents from around the region.

Given our strictly organized society and highly influential culture, we have risen to a position most other peoples can only dream of. However, we may yet face insurmountable, unforeseeable threats. Will we be able to further build and develop our society, or will our glories be lost, and forgotten forever?
entities.name: Cahokia

desc: t

Guided by the sun god, Inti, the first of our leaders founded Qusqu on the precise spot where his golden staff sank into the earth. After centuries of living alongside other groups, the inca_culture finally achieved dominance, and we established ourselves as the scions of this beautiful place. The high volcanoes and rushing rivers of the Andes Mountains shelter and nourish the Sacred Valley of the Incas, where we, the sons of the Sun, dwell in our magnificent city and make ready for the glorious future awaiting us. From our towering bulwark of mountains to our bountiful terraced farmlands, other nations can only gaze in envy at our riches.

After years of power consolidation and politics, the time has come for our people to expand their influence outside our precious valley; to defeat our enemies and follow the paths of the mountains until we stand in each corner of this world. Are we prepared to face this destiny? Or will our enemies defeat us before we can reach our prime?
entities.name: Qusqu

desc: t

Rising from the aftermath of a civil war with the Ngô dynasty in 968, the Kingdom of Đại Việt has struggled ever since against the Chinese Empire's rapidly expanding sphere of influence to the north. Although part of the Middle Kingdom, the GetCountry('DAI') people have had to defend their lands from GetCountry('CHI') invaders on multiple occasions, breeding powerful, long-lasting resentments.

Aide from external threats, the GetCountry('DAI') also faces the problems caused by a highly decentralized state, with the additional challenges brought by both Autonomous Villages, and a volatile court life where hostile actors constantly seek to seize the Đại Việt throne.

Despite all these obstacles, Đại Việt finds itself in an opportunistic situation, as the Kingdom of Champa is surrounded by enemies and ripe for the taking, and Khmer faces internal decay at every front. This must be a sign that the ascension of the GetCountry('DAI') to become the mightiest empire in Indochina is finally at hand!
entities.name: Đại Việt

desc: t

Long a powerful player on the world stage, the Kingdom of Denmark now finds itself in quite a precarious situation. During the previous rule of dan_chistopher_ii, large portions of the country were mortgaged to prominent members of the Danish and German Nobility, the Duchy of Schleswig was forcibly separated from the crown lands, and even the territory of Scania had to be sold to the Kingdom of Sweden. This shameful state of affairs worsened when dan_chistopher_ii was dethroned by shl_gerhard_iii_holstein_rendsburg after installing his own nephew dan_valdemar_iii on the throne, only to ultimately be brought back again as a puppet king. Since dan_chistopher_ii's death, shl_gerhard_iii_holstein_rendsburg has been the de facto ruler of Denmark.

It will not be easy to overcome this situation, but Danish are resilient and resolute, and dan_valdemar_atterdag, son of dan_chistopher_ii is already crafting a plan to recover the authority of the GetCountry('DAN'). Whether it will be successful or not remains to be seen.
entities.name: Denmark

desc: t

The County of Durham is no ordinary lordship, but a GetCountry('DHM') under the Kingdom of England, where the GetCountry('DHM') rules with near-regal authority. Entrusted with powers to raise armies, mint coinage, and administer justice, the Bishop of Durham acts as a temporal prince over his domain in Northumbria.

For generations, this exceptional autonomy has allowed the bishops to guard the northern frontier from Scottish raids, their fortified seat at Durham a bastion of loyalty amidst the marches.

Yet the times are uncertain. The border grows restless, Scotland remains hostile, and even amongst the GetCountry('DHM'), murmurs of reform and ambition stir. Though cloaked in sacred robes, the GetCountry('DHM') of Durham stands as a political creature — and one who may yet rise to play a greater role in the affairs of the realm.

Will the GetCountry('DHM') remain a quiet corner of royal service, or could it become a power in its own right, a great northern kingdom in all but name?
entities.name: Durham

desc: t

A series of swift and decisive conquests in the last century gave birth to our great Kingdom of Delhi. With territories under our jurisdiction spanning from from Deccan to the fertile fields of Lahore, no other civilization can match our prestigious accomplishments.

However, it has become apparent that we have overextended our authority across such a vast GetCountry('DLH'); it is becoming increasingly difficult to control nowadays. Our enemies are many, and they seek to nullify our superior heritage and sophisticated culture. To the east, our subjects in Bengal have started questioning their masters, while our southern territories have long disputed our hold over them. And the Hinduism countries of Southern India may further entrench their resistance to our rule, led by the rising power of Vijayanagar.

While this situation feels precarious, we trust the guidance of dlh_muhammad_bin_tughluq, whose watchful eye may safeguard our lands against threats, and thus prevent our downfall...
entities.name: Delhi

desc: t

The County of Desmond lies in the rugged southwestern reaches of Ireland. Though far from Dublin, it is no remote backwater — it is ruled by dms_maurice_fitzgerald, 1st Earl of Desmond, head of the southern branch of the mighty Fitzgerald, and one of the most powerful lords in all of Ireland.

Granted his earldom in 1329, he carved out a semi-independent domain from the Gaelic chiefs of Thomond and the English crown authority of Pale.

The Earldom is marked by shifting alliances, rival marcher barons, and persistent tension with both Dublin and London. As English royal power wanes in the west, we may seize the opportunity to assert autonomy, play the Gaelic clans against each other, or even claim kingship in all but name.

Will Desmond become a linchpin of a new Hiberno-Norman resurgence? Or will it be swallowed by the tide of Gaelic reconquest and the feuds of rival dynasties?
entities.name: Desmond

desc: t

The English crown is still reeling from the treacherous rebellion that occurred ten year prior and resulted in the underhanded assassination of GetCharacter('eng edward ii'). Although the ringleaders were executed, several co-conspirators have been granted mercy in the name of peace — a peace which could easily be shattered at any moment.

Meanwhile, GetCharacter('eng edward ii')'s surviving heir, GetCharacter('eng edward iii'), has already proven to be a capable young ruler, and is making bold designs on the French throne — a throne which is his birthright as the grandson of a Capet ruler.

In the north, the misguided Balliol weakly contends for the Scottish crown, while our loyal vassals maintain a tight grip on the governments of Wales, Pale, and Aquitaine.

How shall we brave the turbulent years to come? Will we cross the channel and become a continental power, or should we look to the seas for global dominion?
entities.name: England

desc: t

Founded by ere_eretna, an Ilkhanid officer of Uyghur origin, this Beylik state emerged after his victory at the Battle of Karanbük against Mongolian warlords. Declaring independence from his former overlords, ere_eretna became the sultan and earned the nickname ''Köse Peyghamber'', 'the Beardless Prophet', for his prosperous reign. A series of turbulent reigns and constant war plague an already-unstable region, as Anatolia dances closer to the brink of an all-out war...
entities.name: Eretnids

desc: t

The Empire of Ethiopia is an ancient land rich with history and traditions. Nestled in the Horn of Africa, it boasts lush highlands, windswept plateaus, and the incomparable Great Rift Valley. Newcomers are captivated by its beauty, entranced by the golden sunsets against the Simien Mountains.

Ethiopia's enchanting tapestry weaves together diverse ethnic groups like the Amhara, Afar, and Tigre. United by trials, Ethiopia remains resilient like an ancient baobab tree, enduring through time.

Inspired by these ancient origins, Ethiopia cherishes legendary unions like that of the Queen of Sheba and King Solomon. The legacy of their son Menelik, the first member of the Solomon dynasty, echoes through the ages, connecting people of this land to the ancient Israelites.

Through the years, Ethiopia's epic tale unfolds, shaped by destiny and the unwavering spirit of its people. Triumphs and tribulations weave a rich tapestry of life's ebb and flow.

However, this nation is a realm encircled by adversaries who eagerly await any opportunity to strike. Managing not only to survive, but thrive, will be a challenge.
entities.name: Ethiopia

desc: t

Nestled in the borderlands between Wales and the heartlands of the Kingdom of England, the County of Ewyas holds a vital strategic position as one of the marcher lordships charged with securing the realm's western frontier.

The current ruler, eng_bartholomew_burghersh_the_elder, is a loyal servant of the Crown and a veteran of both war and courtly life. A trusted retainer of GetCharacter('eng edward iii'), he has proven himself not only on the battlefield, but also as a royal envoy and administrator, serving at times as Constable of Dover and Warden of the Cinque Ports. His landed authority in the Marches gives him both wealth and reach, though he remains ever vigilant against the shifting loyalties and ambitions that define the region.

Will the Burghersh line maintain its favor with the Burghersh and guard the Marches with honor? Or will the shifting tides of politics, war, and inheritance sweep away this marcher stronghold?
entities.name: Ewyas

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

The Franco-Flemish war, which lasted from 1297 to 1305, deeply impacted Duchy of Flanders. While we managed to stay independent, our struggle culminated with the loss of the Roman Flanders to Kingdom of France.

As one of the richest nations in the region, Flanders has recovered in the past few years, and we might now have the opportunity to reclaim what it is rightfully ours.
entities.name: Flanders

desc: t

The Florentine domain stands strong at the cusp of a new age! Our republic has stood the test of time and is located in a prime position to take advantage of our region's prosperity and affluence. Around us, rival states and potential allies all make their moves in a bid to influence and expand their territories in Italy.

However, few are as well known for their aptitude in arts and cultural influence as those in our forums of thought in Florence. Under the guidance of a capable administration and an educated population, the coming century will elevate our people and have us shine brightly as pioneering innovators during a time of great enlightenment. Provided we establish ourselves as such, of course...
entities.name: Florence

desc: t

The death of GetCharacter('fra charles iv capet') without a male heir in 1328 marked the end of Capet rule over the Kingdom of France, resulting in the coronation of fra_philip_vi_valois, a relative from a former cadet branch of the dynasty. However, this claim has been contested by eng_edward_iii of England, on the pretext that while the Salic Law of France forbids the passing of the throne to a female successor, it does not forbid inheritance through a female line. As the son of eng_isabella_of_france, the last living sibling of fra_charles_iv_capet, eng_edward_iii might claim the throne of France as his birthright.

The tension between both countries has worsened over the past years, as our hospitality of the exiled young ruler of Scotland, sco_david_ii, has enraged the English court, which supports the rival Balliol claimant to the Scottish throne. As a response, eng_edward_iii has also recently granted refuge to eng_robert_iii_artois, who escaped calls to face trial in Paris for his attempts to seize the County of Artois. There are rumors that eng_robert_iii_artois is even encouraging the disgruntled eng_edward_iii to press his claim to the throne of France militarily.

Should relations reach a boiling point, fra_philip_vi_valois may require the support of GetCharacter('fra philip vi valois') subjects, although more than one ambitious Appanage hailing from the old royal line may seize the opportunity to demand greater privileges, proving a greater threat to the stability of the crown than any invading claimant. The upcoming years will be consequential for the future of France, having to face external English menace and the proud French lords at once. Will the country fall to the fake pretenders, or emerge as the main power in Europe?
entities.name: France

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Encircled by feudal lords, our society is currently divided between those who wish to retain our independence, and those that are slowly gaining power by adopting the foreign ways of the neighboring nations. The County of Frisia has therefore arrived at a crossroads, while still dreaming of our past glory. Are we finally ready to step forward and declare ourselves for one side or the other?
entities.name: Frisia

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

The most warlike nation in the region, the County of Guelders is also very competent in diplomacy. Their expansion was engineered not only by the sword, but also with bags of gold. The beautiful synthesis of these two tools provided us with the opportunity to rise above our inferior rivals.
entities.name: Guelders

desc: t

The city of Genoa stands out as the most important commercial port in the Western Mediterranean, its GetCountry('GEN') having greatly expanded its influence overseas through trade and war.

After defeating the County of Pisa, it gained the island of Corsica and established a foothold in Sardinia. However, this might have been a poisonous gift, as Genoa may now face not only opposition from its inhabitants, but also from ara_peter_iv_arago, self-proclaimed sovereign of both islands.

Another challenge could arise from the east, as our wide network has created the conditions for commercial dominance over the Black Sea, centered around the port of Kaffa, although dangerous neighbors such as Venice, Byzantium, or the Kingdom of Jochi might be a threat.

Relying on our numerous Fondaco and wealthy bankers, will Genoa be able to overcome these challenges?
entities.name: Genoa

desc: t

Georgian people are proud of their long history, for their ancestors were already living at the foot of the Caucasus before the empires of antiquity were even founded. They were among the first to embrace Christianity, and embraced the faith as part of their identity. Even after the expansion of Islam, and becoming surrounded by heathen nations, they held on to their faith and became a bulwark of Christianity on the border between the East and the West.

Not even the Mongol hordes of GetCharacter('genghis khan') Khān managed to fully subjugate the Georgian people, for they rose again in defiance once the Mongol threat waned.

Having been united once before under a great kingdom, the Georgian people now have the potential to achieve legendary heights once again.

We achieved our most splendid accomplishments during the rule of geo_david_iv and geo_tamar_the_great. Now, after having been divided for too long, the Kingdom of Georgia is once again united under the authority of geo_george_v, after GetCharacter('geo george v') conquered western Georgia and reasserted GetCharacter('geo george v') rule over all the Georgian territory. Even Armenia bows now to the power of Georgia.

Although still technically subject to the Īlkhānān, they are greatly fractured, and Georgia finds itself within an empty husk, waiting for a strong leader to rise from within and take control. Under these circumstances, how could Georgia not be reborn greater than ever before?
entities.name: Georgia

desc: t

The great GetCharacter('genghis khan') Khān forged an empire of unparalleled strength and ambition for all Mongol peoples, bringing into his fold great swathes of land from Europe to China. People everywhere learned to fear the sound of the Mongol armies galloping through, and the might and power of the Great Khān.

As heirs of this legacy, our dream of restoring the glory of the greatest Mongol Horde burns passionately within us all. It was jochi_borjigin, son of Genghis Khān, and his son batu_borjigin who carried on the legacy of the Great Khān and established the Kingdom of Jochi.

Controlling the westernmost expansion of the great empire, we are the rulers of the vast steppes. Many nations in Europe  are subservient to us, afraid of our legendary might. As they should be...
entities.name: Jochi

desc: t

Rising from the remains of the Seljuk Empire, Germiyanids established a strong foothold in the region under the leadership of grm_yakub_i. After rebelling against Seljuk authority in 1283, our great people finally attained peace in 1314, gaining an impressive array of territories, including the vital city of Ankara. A series of turbulent reigns and constant war plague an already-unstable region, as Anatolia dances closer to the brink of an all-out war...
entities.name: Germiyanids

desc: t

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of ubv_ludwig_iv_wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of GetCountry('UBV'), GetCountry('BOH'), and GetCountry('HAB') once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

Due to the diligent efforts of hab_albrecht_ii_habsburg and his predecessors, Austria successfully expanded and solidified its rule in Lower Austria, Styria, and Carinthia. With their position on the south-eastern borders of the Holy Roman Empire secured, Austria can now look towards the grand prize the Habsburg are determined to reclaim: the imperial crown of the Holy Roman Empire.
entities.name: Austria

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Thanks to a clever royal marriage policy, the counties of Hainaut, Holland and Zeeland have come under the rule of  the Avesnes dynasty. The County of Hainaut now has the opportunity to continue unifying the region under its leadership. But this will be no easy feat...
entities.name: Hainaut

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

For centuries, the great Kingdom of Hungary has defended this bastion of Catholicism from the pagans and heathens that threaten beyond. After the national unification was achieved, the glorious formation of the Kingdom of Goryeo brought about a golden period of prosperity and unprecedented unity to its people. Even after bending to kublai_khan, Goryeo continues to be an significant power, both due to its highly educated population and its mighty naval force.

Now the winds of change are blowing, as the corruption of Buddhism ideals and the galvanizing, revolutionary ideas of Neo-Confucianism are changing minds all over the country. Will Goryeo transform into the strongest soldier in China's army, or will it break free from those shackles and dictate its future?

Our nation is a center of education of the highest degree, and therefore wields powerful influence over neighboring states. This influence will certainly ensure our ascent as a nation, should we use it wisely.

Deep in those woods, riches of Iron and Copper remain hidden, waiting to be used to enrich our country.

Our GetCountry('SWE') currently faces grave challenges, fallout from our recent clash with the mercantile power Duchy of Velikiy Novgorod over Ingria. Meanwhile, the Kingdom of Denmark and the Duchy of Teutons control most of the lands to the south — lands that we could govern and exploit with much more finesse.

Sweden is positioned to be one of the foremost nations in the world. Will we be able to defeat our challenges, take our rightful place of power, and establish the ''Dominium Maris Baltici'' - the Dominion over the Baltic Sea?
entities.name: Sweden

desc: t

The glorious ''Order of Brothers of the German House of Saint Mary in Jerusalem'', also known as the Duchy of Teutons, face their destiny on the stormy coasts of the Baltic Sea. Created to protect the Christianity pilgrims on their way to the Holy City of Jerusalem, its objective shifted to Christianize the Pagan tribes of Prussia and the Baltic through the creation of a state in those lands.

Under the leadership of our predecessor, teu_werner_von_orseln, the Duchy of Teutons expanded its territorial holdings, but this expansion has not come without consequences. The Order's aggressive policies have created powerful enemies, as the Pagan tribes to the East have united against us and formed the Duchy of Lithuania. Worse, they then allied with our Catholicism southern neighbor and rival, the Kingdom of Poland, which has abandoned its Christianity duty and joined with the Pagans against us.

The time has come for our Order to prove that we are up to the crusading task that we have set for ourselves, and show the world that even surrounded by enemies, our faith stands triumphant.
entities.name: Teutons

desc: t

Descendants of Ireland's great High King, mcm_brian_boruma, our proud clan o_brien_dynasty once ruled all of Munster, the southern fifth of the isle. Our ancient kingdom was splintered by the despicable mac_carthaigh_dynasty clan, who seized our territories and forced us northwards.

Our new realm of Thomond, guarding the mouth of the great River Shannon, sits vulnerable. We are surrounded by powerful lords and tense relationships, both of ancient Irish kingdoms and the new Anglo-Irish Earldoms.

Will we reclaim our righteous title as Kings of Munster, or will we go further and once again unite the High Kingship under the banner of o_brien_dynasty?
entities.name: Thomond

desc: t

For the past two centuries, groups of Nahua people descended from the Chichimec migrated to central Mexico from their legendary ancestral home, known as Aztlan. Our people were one of those wandering groups. As with many other Nahua nations, we established our own Āltepētl called Tenōchtitlan, which was built on an artificial island in the heart of Lake Texcoco.

Our most prominent figures were also influenced by the Toltec culture, and as a result, we have developed a refined and sophisticated civilization, cradled in the lagoon. We are also recognized as skilled fighters by our neighbors, as our equally refined battle skills have made the armies of the Aztecs, the descendants of Aztlan, a force to be feared...

However, we currently stand as vassals of the Āltepētl of Tepanecapan, and as such, our expansion possibilities are limited to the areas around the lagoon we inhabit. Only a brilliant and capable ruler could possibly lead the Aztecs in our journey to subdue the Valley of Mexico and conquer lands beyond — could it be GetCountry('TNC')?
entities.name: Tenōchtitlan

desc: t

The last vestige of a once-powerful dynasty, the GetCountry('TRE') now rule over the Empire of Trebizond, gazing across the Black Sea. Having witnessed the rise and fall of the Nicean Empire, as the Turkic raiders reign across Anatolia, tre_basil_komnenos now depends on a shaky alliance with Byzantium to weather the storm. At the same time, merchants from Genoa have all but monopolized the trade influx that passes through Crimea and the Black Sea, siphoning much coin from the coffers of Trapezuntine. The marriage to the illegitimate daughter of byz_andronikos_iii_palaiologos has gone cold, and the situation in the capital grows even more dire under the pressure of southern raids and internal conflicts with the Scholarioi...

Be it through cunning, gold, or force, we must tighten our trembling grasp on power if we are to preserve everything we have fought for.
entities.name: Trebizond

desc: t

The Beylik of the Ottomans was founded by tur_osman, a chieftain of the Kayı tribe of the Oghuz Turks, around 1299. Occupying the Northwestern coast region of Anatolia, they were initially one of the many Beyliks to occupy the border territory of Rûm, a once-powerful Sultanate. Under the leadership of tur_orhan, they have consolidated and greatly expanded their domain, securing vital land along the coast of the Bosphorus. Bountiful raids, military victories, and cunning diplomacy have set them apart as one of the region's most powerful rising Beyliks. Adaptive and innovative, our culture is a unique blend of regional ways and mores, where religious tolerance and strategic incorporation of conquered peoples make our society a brilliant mosaic of humanity.

The Beylik of the Ottomans is the ultimate example of sophisticated civilization, but that does not mean we are safe from all harm. Internal strife caused by friction between autonomous tribes and a series of succession crises concerns us, as does the persistent threat represented by our Byzantine and Ilkhanate neighbors, to say nothing of rival Beyliks.

Yet, despite these dogs nipping at our heels, we march proudly towards the future. Whether it is a future of conquest, diplomacy, trade, or art is yet to be determined...
entities.name: Ottomans

desc: t

The Heartland of the Holy Roman Empire has endured the long period of the Great Interregnum, and looks to the future with grave concern. In the face of ubv_ludwig_iv_wittelsbach's advancing age, the families of GetCountry('UBV'), GetCountry('BOH'), and GetCountry('HAB') once more prepare for competition over the crown. While Imperial authority south of the Alps is deteriorating, German merchants scramble to secure their trade routes into Italy, as the Duchy of Hansa relish their dominance over the region of Northern Germany.

Under the Leadership of ubv_ludwig_iv_wittelsbach, Bavaria is now at the height of its power. As GetCharacter('ubv ludwig iv wittelsbach') is the Emperor of the Holy Roman Empire, the Duchy of Upper Bavaria commands particular respect and authority among the Imperial leaders. While the Duchy of Lower Bavaria is currently ruled by lbv_heinrich_xiv_wittelsbach, his health is steadily declining due to leprosy, and GetCharacter('lbv heinrich xiv wittelsbach') predicted early death could spark a reunification of Bavaria.

Given the strong relationships between the GetCountry('UBV') rulers of Europe, Bavaria is ready to claim its right to rule the Holy Roman Empire and exert its authority over central Europe, challenging their rivals in Bohemia and Austria.
entities.name: Upper Bavaria

desc: t

The once proud County of Ulster is in shatters. In 1333, uls_william_donn_de_burgh_3rd_earl_ulster was murdered, leaving the infant GetCharacter('uls elizabeth de burgh 4th countess ulster') as the sole heir. The junior Burgh clans of Clanricarde, Mayo, and Clanwilliam have taken advantage of our weakness, and now compete amongst each other for control over all the family lands.

Meanwhile, the feuding Neill chieftains of Tyrone and Clandeboye lay waste our rightful territory, exploiting our misfortune.

The weakened crown administration of Pale is beset by troubles, and is too weak to interfere; for now, we can only bide our time from the safety of the impregnable fortress of Carrickfergus. Will we fade into obscurity, or regain our position as the preeminent Anglo-Irish power?
entities.name: Ulster

desc: t

The nations in the Low Countries have been bounded and bossed around by both the Kingdom of France or the Holy Roman Empire since their creation, often becoming a fief of one or the other and not rarely switching sides. Like a big prize waiting for a claimant, as one of the richest regions in Europe, the countries of the region are in a position where they have to decide whether they will become an integral part of other nations or will defend their independence with fury.

Harassed for too long by the County of Guelders and the County of Holland, the County of Utrecht is trying to shake off their influence and unite all the Low Countries under our divinely favored guidance. The bustling city of Utrecht, a center of culture and art, would make an excellent capital for a unified region. Let us hope that others agree... preferably without too much resistance.
entities.name: Utrecht

desc: t

The Most Serene Republic of Venice is the most important and powerful merchant republic in the Mediterranean Sea. It controls important trade ports and islands which form the ''Stado do Mar'', and many inland territories in the North of Italy, which form the ''Domini di Terraferma''. Flush with prosperity from its extensive trade network, Venice is a beacon of wealth and culture, a lagoon-cradled jewel shining in the Adriatic Sea.

Nonetheless, this elegant city cannot lower its guard, as new threats arise around it. In the East, the once-great Empire of Byzantium will not easily forget the Fourth Crusade, nor the Venetian involvement in it. In the West, the Duchy of Genoa and the Crown of Aragon continue to expand their influence, conquering more territory and dominating trade routes. Finally, the County of Verona have become a palpable threat to the ''Domini di Terraferma''.

What will the future hold for the GetCountry('VEN')? Will it fall under the pressure of its enemies, or will it rise to the top and become the indisputable ruler of the ''Mare Nostrum''?
entities.name: Venice

desc: t

The newly founded Kingdom of Vijayanagar stands strong after the momentous defeat of Dehlavi troops in the Deccan, when vij_harihara_sangama and his brother vij_bukka_raya_sangama lead the fight against the Islam rulers of India.

Although Vijayanagari rule has only recently been established, the current situation in the Deccan promises us a rapid rise to power if we can utilize our momentum correctly, as we can secure control over important trade routes between China and Europe, and profit of exporting valuable goods from our resource-rich lands.

Vijayanagar is on the verge of a monumental step forward. Will we stumble, or proudly stand above the rest?
entities.name: Vijayanagar

desc: t

The Welsh people descend from the ancient Celtic inhabitants of Britain; their domain stretched from the misty northern highlands to the rugged chalk cliffs of the southern coast. A land of fae and poets, of rain and sea, Wales was extraordinary in many ways. But Welsh dominion over their native lands could not be sustained.

First, the Anglo-Saxon warlords came, filling the power vacuum left by the fallen Roman Empire, and pushing the natives to the rocky peripheries of Britannia. Then came the Norman adventurers, who finally subjugated them and dethroned their rightful rulers.

Today, our fortified administration rules at the behest of the English GetCountry('ENG'), with authority over the Anglo-Norman marches of the southern valleys and the Welsh settlements of the northern mountains.

But beneath the songs of our musicians and the steady drum of rain, there lies a murmur of rebellion. Will Wales be led to prosperity in the name of the Plantagenet kings, or will the Land of Our Fathers rise again? We are still here!
entities.name: Wales

desc: t

The Kingdom of Kilwa is firmly established as a powerful maritime state along the Swahili Coast, having expanded its influence over a vast swath of the Indian Ocean trade network. For more than a century, Kilwa's rulers capitalized on their strategic position, controlling the lucrative trade routes that connected Africa, Arabia, India, and even China.

Their wealth is built on the exchange of gold from the interior of Africa, as well as Ivory, Slaves, and other local goods for luxury items such as Farsi silks, Indian textiles, and Chinese porcelain. Kilwa's prosperity is reflected in the grandeur of its architecture, which symbolizes Kilwan power and sophistication.

But our prosperity cannot protect us from everything. Even now, the masters of Zimbabwe are consolidating their power to the Southwest, as competition in foreign markets grows ever fiercer.

What mysteries does the future hold for the GetCountry('ZAN')? Only time will tell.
entities.name: Kilwa

desc: t

Controlling the great riches of Southeast Africa, the Kingdom of Zimbabwe enjoys a period of stability and peace. Trade with merchants from the Swahili Coast is flourishing and ensures the steady supply of foreign goods from as far away as India and China, while the mines of the African interior seem to offer a never-ending supply of riches. Our capital, the largest city in the region, is renowned far and wide for its glorious edifices of stone, which will stand forever as testaments to Zimbabwe achievement.

Despite all this, however, trouble stalks our great nation. We cannot rely forever on our resources, and our arid climate often leads to failed harvests. Our population is relatively small. And, while we are a major trading power, the balance could slip at any moment to favor another if we are not careful. We also struggle with external threats from our covetous neighbors.

What will become of this promising nation? Can Zimbabwe overcome its numerous barriers and realize its potential as the leader of the entire Swahili Coast? Or will it be torn apart by the twin jackals of external and internal conflict?
entities.name: Zimbabwe
